content.name: Sovereign Glue
entries: This viscous, milky-white substance can form a permanent adhesive bond between any two objects. It must be stored in a jar or flask that has been coated inside with {@item oil of slipperiness}. When found, a container contains {@dice 1d6 + 1} ounces.

One ounce of the glue can cover a 1-foot square surface. The glue takes 1 minute to set. Once it has done so, the bond it creates can be broken only by the application of {@item universal solvent} or {@item oil of etherealness}, or with a {@spell wish} spell.

content.name: Sovereign Glue
entries: This viscous, milky-white substance can form a permanent adhesive bond between any two objects. It must be stored in a jar or flask that has been coated inside with {@item Oil of Slipperiness|SRD52}. When found, a container contains {@dice 1d6 + 1} ounces.

One ounce of the glue can cover a 1-foot square surface. Applying an ounce of Sovereign Glue takes a {@action Utilize|SRD52} action, and the applied glue takes 1 minute to set. Once it has done so, the bond it creates can be broken only by the application of {@item Universal Solvent|SRD52} or {@item Oil of Etherealness|SRD52}, or with a {@spell Wish|SRD52} spell.
